name: EPIC 212362642

text.card: A red giant 3,443 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.83 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,906 K at its surface.
